subject: client-sdk portability adapter
target_surface: futures executor and opposite I/O trait family
preserved_constraints: Tokio-based types still require a Tokio context to be usable.
The adapter may create or enter a Tokio runtime context, but it does not prove the future is polled by a Tokio runtime.
capabilities_helped: manual entry into Tokio context for futures that use Tokio types
not_solved: A library's hidden dependence on specific Tokio resource-driver configuration
residual_review_debt: Callers still need an explicit capability-route receipt for Tokio time or I/O features if those are relied on.
The exported support bundle should still say whether a Tokio runtime context is created globally or provided externally.
notes: Compatibility adapters are useful substrate, not automatic lock-in erasers.
